text: Tivoli Alvor Algarve is a five-star all-inclusive resort just outside Alvor, and the closest golf course is [Alto Golf](/courses/alto-golf), about **5 minutes** away by car. The two Sir Henry Cotton courses at [Penina](/courses/penina-championship) are about 16 minutes away, and [Pestana Ferragudo](/courses/pestana-ferragudo), Pestana's Carvoeiro courses, [Morgado](/courses/morgado) and [Palmares](/courses/palmares) are all within about half an hour. **Last checked: November 2026.**

text: The nearest courses at a glance
Slope ratings are from the Portuguese Golf Federation for the back tees: the higher the number, the harder the course for an average golfer.

**[Alto Golf](/courses/alto-golf)** (par 70, 5,432 m, slope 130): the last course Sir Henry Cotton designed, run by Pestana. It's one of the few full-length courses that accepts a **handicap of up to 36 for men as well as ladies**, so it suits higher handicappers. Undulating, with sloping greens. Twilight is €50. See the [Alto Golf scorecard](/courses/alto-golf/scorecard).

**[Penina Championship](/courses/penina-championship)** (par 73, 6,273 m, slope 143): Cotton's 1966 course, the first in the Algarve, which the club says has hosted the Portuguese Open ten times. Flat, but the hardest course near the hotel on slope. See the [Penina hole-by-hole guide](/courses/penina-championship/hole-by-hole).

**[Penina Resort Course](/courses/penina-resort)** (9 holes, par 35, 2,987 m): a full-length nine beside the Championship course that **doesn't ask for a handicap**, so it's a good start for newer golfers.
**[Pestana Ferragudo](/courses/pestana-ferragudo)** (par 72, 5,841 m, slope 118): Pestana's newest course, opened in 2026, and the easiest 18 near the hotel on slope.

**[Morgado](/courses/morgado)** (par 73, 6,581 m, slope 134): golfers describe its fairways as wide and forgiving, and the back nine is hillier, so a buggy is recommended. Golfers find its sister course, [Alamos](/courses/alamos), tighter; it's about 31 minutes from the hotel. See [Alamos vs Morgado](/guide/alamos-vs-morgado-which-portimao-golf-course-should-you-play).
**[Palmares](/courses/palmares)** (27 holes, slope 129 to 134): Robert Trent Jones Jr.'s course between the sea and the hills at Lagos, with three nines and real elevation changes.
Golf at Tivoli Alvor

Tivoli Alvor doesn't have its own golf course, and we didn't find a golf desk, golf shuttle or golf package on its official websites, which only say there are several courses close by. UK golf tour operators do sell packages here with rounds at nearby courses, so compare those with booking your rounds directly with the clubs.

As an all-inclusive resort, it suits a family holiday with a few rounds: there's a spa with an indoor heated pool, the Pluma Junior Club for children aged 4 to 12, with its own minigolf, and a complimentary shuttle into Alvor and down to the beach. See [all-inclusive golf hotels in the Algarve](/guide/all-inclusive-golf-hotels-in-the-algarve) for what all-inclusive covers for golfers.

text: Which course to play from Tivoli Alvor
**For the shortest drive,** Alto Golf is 5 minutes away. Compare it with Penina in [Alto Golf vs Penina Championship](/guide/alto-golf-vs-penina-championship-which-portimao-course-should-you-play).

**For history,** play the Penina Championship course. If you're choosing between Penina's two courses, read [Penina Championship vs Penina Resort](/guide/penina-championship-vs-penina-resort-which-course-should-you-play).
**For a higher handicap,** Alto Golf accepts up to 36 for men, and the Penina Resort Course doesn't ask for a handicap at all.

**For more choices nearby,** see our page on [golf near Alvor](/alvor/golf-courses), which covers every course within half an hour of the town, and [hotels near Penina](/guide/hotels-near-penina-golf-resort) for other places to stay.
Getting there

Tivoli Alvor is about **1 hour and 75 km from Faro Airport** by car, without traffic. See [Faro Airport to Portimão and Alvor for golfers](/guide/faro-airport-to-portimao-and-alvor-for-golfers) for taxis, transfers and car hire.
Golf near Tivoli Alvor: common questions
What is the closest golf course to Tivoli Alvor?
Alto Golf, about 5 minutes away by car. The Penina Championship and Resort courses are about 16 minutes away.
Does Tivoli Alvor have a golf course?
No. It has a minigolf course for children in its junior club, but no full golf course. The nearest is Alto Golf.
Does Tivoli Alvor sell golf packages?
We didn't find one on its official websites, but UK golf tour operators sell packages at the resort with rounds at nearby courses.
Do I need a handicap to play near Tivoli Alvor?

At most 18-hole courses, yes, usually up to 28 for men and 36 for ladies. Alto Golf accepts 36 for men too, and the Penina Resort Course doesn't ask for one. See [do you need a handicap to play golf in the Algarve?](/guide/do-you-need-a-handicap-to-play-golf-in-the-algarve)
